_comment: Scenes of the reference clip and the game shot that answers each: frame of docs/reference/frames, game query, hour, seconds of play, inspect camera (alpha,beta,radius,height above the ship's centre), optional script run every frame (shot.mjs SHOT_SCRIPT). tools/shots/reference-sheet.mjs <out-dir> [scene ...].

deck.script: const s=b.session.sim; const me=s.player(); if (me.ship.sailTarget[0] !== 2) s.command({ type: "sails", ship: me.id, mast: "all", level: 2 });
